invariants.name: Scope containment
invariants.rule: Every path in the diff matches a glob in capability.scope.

invariants.name: Full suite green
invariants.rule: Zero failing test ids on sqlite and on postgres.

invariants.name: Test set integrity
invariants.rule: Every base test id exists at head and passes, removals carry reason_code and covered_by, no skip or xfail is added, no assertion count is lowered, and no added assertion matches a tautology pattern.

invariants.name: Test-infrastructure containment
invariants.rule: No diff touches a path in gate.test_infra_paths unless that path is in capability.scope.

invariants.name: Added-test falsifiability
invariants.rule: Every added test fails on base with fail_kind ASSERTION and passes on head; a base-green test is NON_FALSIFIABLE unless named in characterization_tests; acceptance is re-derived when the acceptance author family equals the builder family.

invariants.name: Mutation adequacy
invariants.rule: Kill ratio is at or above the tier threshold and every changed hunk in a high-tier path has at least one killed mutant.

invariants.name: Changelog coverage
invariants.rule: Every added row names a subset of diff paths and every non-exempt diff path appears in at least one added row.

invariants.name: Secret scan
invariants.rule: Secret scan reports zero hits on added lines beyond secrets-baseline.json.

invariants.name: Lint convention
invariants.rule: The ruff rule set reports zero violations on added lines.

invariants.name: Smell delta
invariants.rule: No new smell appears on an added line; pre-existing smells that the diff did not increase are residual.

invariants.name: Gate negative controls
invariants.rule: Every known-bad fixture is rejected, controls_total meets each per-check minimum and known_bad_min (total_min is the declared-entry floor), and controls_rejected equals controls_total for the current gate_sha, control_set_sha, and policy_digest.

invariants.name: Policy digest binding
invariants.rule: Hash all security-deciding files under policies/** listed in policy_digest.py COVERED (policies/*.json and policies/semgrep.yml except policy-manifest.json) as sorted (relative POSIX path, sha256 of raw bytes) pairs in canonical JSON; a changed digest requires a gate-control record carrying that digest, and a record with a different digest fails as POLICY_DRIFT; a missing covered file is a tool error.

invariants.name: Architecture containment
invariants.rule: A new cross-layer edge, dependency, public export, or unowned module path is refused unless capability.architecture_allow declares it with a reason.

invariants.name: Oracle provenance
invariants.rule: No added assertion line is a SELF_COMPARE, ORACLE_BY_COPY, or MOCK_ECHO according to assert-rules.json.

invariants.name: Guard removal coverage
invariants.rule: Every removed conditional or guard line in a high-tier path is named by an added test covering the changed hunk or by capability.guard_delta.

invariants.name: Authorization matrix
invariants.rule: Every URLconf route and method has a matrix row and each role client is compared with the view's declared permission classes.

invariants.name: Semantic grep ruleset
invariants.rule: The project ruleset in policies/semgrep.yml reports zero new findings on added lines, each with its policy class tag.

invariants.name: Thread and process race
invariants.rule: When the closure touches a lock, atomic block, idempotency key, or watermark, added concurrency tests run on postgres for the tier's repetitions per worker and reproduce the protected property every time.

invariants.name: OpenAPI schema fuzz
invariants.rule: schemathesis runs with the fixed seed on added routes and changed shapes and observes no schema violation or 5xx response.

invariants.name: Production boot test
invariants.rule: The app boots with production settings and DEBUG=false, answers a health probe, and exits non-zero when a required environment variable is removed.

invariants.name: GitHub Actions hardening
invariants.rule: When .github/** is in the closure, or weekly on base otherwise, zizmor reports no finding above the policy threshold.

invariants.name: Dynamic application security baseline
invariants.rule: At max only, the ZAP baseline scan against the hacker runtime has no alert above the policy threshold; informational alerts are residual.

invariants.name: Record hash integrity
invariants.rule: Every sealed ledger record carries sig_status unsigned_local and a record_hash that recomputes as sha256 over canonical JSON of the record minus record_hash.

invariants.name: Hash chain continuity
invariants.rule: Each record's prev_hash equals the previous record's record_hash; the first record uses 64 zeroes.

invariants.name: Unsigned-local sealing
invariants.rule: No signing key exists on the host; every sealed record carries sig_status unsigned_local set by the harness, never by a subagent.

invariants.name: Append-only ledger
invariants.rule: Verdict, status, finding, risk-acceptance, gate-control, and release records are append-only and hash-chained; a write is accepted only with a matching expected_prev_hash and is never retried unchanged after LEDGER_CONFLICT.

invariants.name: Control total exactness
invariants.rule: controls_total equals the count of controls whose expected_outcome is FAIL; PASS controls discriminate but are not counted.

invariants.name: Control rejection completeness
invariants.rule: controls_rejected equals controls_total and every known-bad control is rejected; a single survivor is GATE_CONTROL_FAILURE.

invariants.name: Control minima
invariants.rule: controls_total is at or above known_bad_min and at or above each per-check min_count; pending controls never count, and an under-count is CONTROL_UNDERCOUNT. total_min is the declared-entry floor, not the known-bad comparison.

invariants.name: Policy digest scope
invariants.rule: The gate-control policy digest hashes all security-deciding files under policies/** listed in policy_digest.py COVERED (policies/*.json and policies/semgrep.yml except policy-manifest.json) as sorted (relative POSIX path, sha256 of raw bytes) pairs in canonical JSON; a missing covered file is a tool error.

invariants.name: Permission semantics last-match-wins
invariants.rule: OpenCode V2 evaluates the ordered rule list and the last matching rule wins; every role starts from a blanket deny and adds narrow allows and later denies.

invariants.name: Tier monotonic non-lower
invariants.rule: Within a lineage, tier may be raised by the orchestrator or auditor and may not be lowered by anyone; factory paths map to tier max and variant max, and counters never reset.

invariants.name: AGT narrows only
invariants.rule: Deny in either layer wins; a conjunction control proves a tool denied by permissions stays denied when AGT allows, and a tool allowed by permissions stays denied when AGT denies

invariants.name: AGT policy path
invariants.rule: resolved AGT policy path == repo .agt/policy.json; env override absent or equal

invariants.name: AGT factory paths
invariants.rule: .agt/**, .opencode/plugins/**, opencode.json plugin entry and the lockfile are factory paths, tier max, hashed

invariants.name: AGT pin
invariants.rule: AGT plugin version pinned exactly; lockfile committed; no caret range

invariants.name: AGT audit
invariants.rule: every denied tool call has an AGT audit entry, else finding

invariants.name: AGT mode
invariants.rule: mode=enforce, denyOnPolicyError=true, defaultEffect=deny

invariants.name: Prose tool-call lint
invariants.rule: Every backticked tool.method({...}) call in files/sop/*.md and persona files names a registry tool whose args schema contains every named key and all required keys, and uses no banned raw-shell substitution (git -C, manage.py test, semgrep_runner.py).
